zoe: heads-up - onboarding magnet-30b-v2 int4. Running longprefill with tiled prefill (tiling to reduce GPU mem). Around 15.6k tokens we see odd token swaps where earlier entities appear shifted by one token and occasionally small repeats. float16/int8 clean. Anyone familiar with tiling+kv-indexing corner cases?

alon: tiling can change the mapping between tile-local indices and global KV indices. are you using relative indexing + tiled_prefill_stride?

zoe: flags: `--prefill_mode=stream --tiled_prefill=true --tile_size=4096 --prefill_stride=4096 --kv_index_type=relative --quant=int4 --max-tokens=18000`

prateek: can you paste a tiny KVCACHE_DEBUG snippet near the failure and a sample failing tail? often off-by-one in tile-join causes index shift.

zoe: pasted excerpt and tail:
```
[15588] tile0: write idx=15587 -> tile_local=3563
[15589] tile1: join requested -> global_base=12288
[15590] rel->abs convert rel_idx=15589 -> abs_idx=15589
[15590] rotary_phase: 0.4123 -> 0.4124
[15592] out: "Professor" -> "Professor"
[15595] out: "He" -> "Dr"  <-- unexpected
[15598] out: "said" -> "Professor"  <-- shifted
```

maya: that looks like a mapping bug at join: rel->abs gives 15589 but the join base used was 12288 (tile boundary) - check whether you add tile offsets twice when converting. Also int4 packing could move byte alignment if join does memcpy with off-by-n byte.

alon: quick test: run with `kv_index_type=absolute` and `tiled_prefill=false` to see whether shifting disappears. also run KVCACHE_DEBUG with `KV_TILE_VALIDATE=1` to assert monotonicity of global indices.

zoe: queued three runs: (A) absolute indexing (B) no-tiling (C) KV_TILE_VALIDATE=1. ci job 5101234568 queued.

ci-bot: nightly_pipeline/run/5101234568 - magnet-30b-v2-tiled-prefill-bisect queued. artifacts -> s3://redwood-ci/runs/5101234568/

prateek: if (A) fixes, it's relative->global conversion bug; if (B) fixes, it's tiling assembly; if (C) triggers assertion, we get exact join offset. Also add a unit that replays tile joins with random tile_size and verifies index continuity.

zoe: preliminary: (A) reduced errors but still occasional shift at 16.3k; (B) clean to 18k; (C) assertion fired showing gap at join: expected next_abs = prev_abs + 1 but saw prev_abs + 2.

maya: nice. sounds like an off-by-one when computing the tail pad length during tile copy. Could be integer division rounding in bytes -> nibbles when dealing with int4 packs. Add a check that unpacked KV length equals expected token count before merge.

alon: agree. quick mitigation: in tile-merge path, verify CRC or checksum of unpacked KV and, on mismatch, fallback to scalar unpack/repack. Long-term fix: audit pack/unpack size computations and make them robust to non-multiples of pack width.

prateek: i'll add a unit test fuzzing tile_size 1..8192 with both even and odd pack offsets and assert roundtrip. also adding a CI job that runs tiled_prefill longprefill on a tiny model nightly to catch regressions. cc @maya.

zoe: opening ticket ML-8801 with logs and sample outputs (tail: "...said Professor He said Professor") and attaching the failing packed blob. will follow up when PRs land. thanks all. :thumbsup:
